## Resource navigator for delivery

[Slow AI Kitchen application](https://kitchen.grcskorea.com/)

Use during instruction to navigate steps, roles and risk tiers. Approval of a training exercise does not approve the app for Client data.

[Reference library](https://library.grcskorea.com/)

Find doctrine, methods, assessment tools and audience-specific guidance. Use it as a reading interface and follow its links to the maintained sources.

[Governance ecosystem map](https://github.com/rolldabones/rolldabones/blob/main/ECOSYSTEM.md)

Check how the repositories connect and identify related resources for a specific engagement.

[The Handover](https://redcaps.substack.com/p/the-handover)

The Handover, 28 August 2026. Connects the published argument to the maintained enterprise governance library.

[AI GRC Master List of Questions](https://github.com/rolldabones/AI-GRC-Master-List-of-Questions)

Optional discovery companion for gathering facts needed by the AI GRC Copilot. Apply only within the Client's authorized scope.

[AI Governance for Boards](https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards)

Use for sponsor and board preparation when the selected workflow raises enterprise authority and oversight questions.

[AI Governance Academy](https://github.com/rolldabones/AI-Governance-Academy)

Use when the initial engagement identifies a need for a broader capability-building program. The pack's program options, their constants and its Client-facing publications are stated there; this engagement is not a program option of that pack.

**Companion use**

This repository also carries the [Slow AI Cookbook](https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen/blob/main/slow-ai-cookbook.md), Tier 1 and Tier 2 recipes, and two sample operating prompts, the [compressed builder version](https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen/blob/main/sample-kitchen-prompts-compressed-builder-version.md) and the [two-layer version](https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen/blob/main/sample-kitchen-prompts-two-layer-version.md). Read each scope note before use; the README governs any conflict. Select examples that fit the Client's work and preserve human ownership of criteria, preparation and confirmation.
